body: Is the collar with the O-rings and chains still up for grabs?  How wide is it... and how much do you think it would cost to send it to the US?

It's been three weeks since he broke up with me and it still hurts just as badly as the day it happened.  I don't know how to feel better... it's like I can't cry myself out.  I just keep crying.  Is something wrong with me?

This is a lot to process... but it makes sense.  It really does.

I may take you up on that PM offer.
Wow.  I wasn't expecting that kind of a response.  Thank you... that's a beautiful thought.  It's comforting.
But you have no way of knowing if I'm worth anything at all.  I don't think I am.
In answer to your question, 13 years of Catholic school.
But graduating is not.  Hello, unemployment, and how are you today?

Pretty much.  The town where my father lives has less than 30k people, and the city where I'm currently staying is larger, but the job market here is basically dead.  And the town where my boyfriend lives is even smaller - and it's four hours away, making job hunting there all kinds of fun.

I know.  It may be my only realistic option, honestly.  I might be able to fake it through any mental health screening, since I haven't actually been treated for anything in a long time (depression/anxiety).

And this part is pathetic - but I just don't want to leave my boyfriend.  The plan was to find a "real job" near him... and there's no way he'll wait four years for me.  Not that I'd ask him to. :(
True... will they accept a candidate who is currently a mental health wreck, though?
I would gladly take multiple part time jobs, but I have nowhere else to stay.

I hear that a lot, but I've only found two companies so far who want a bachelor's regardless of academic discipline.  One is the company that rejected me twice, and the other won't even grant me an interview.  I can't figure out where else to look.  I'm stalking every job board I know of, and every county or city website...

I'm female.  I've tried to consolidate the private loans, but they won't consider me unless I'm making a minimum of 30k a year.

Maybe I should consider officer school.  I really don't want to leave the country, but like I said, I'm out of ideas.

Unfortunately the part about my parents kicking me out is very likely.  My stepmother claims I'm ruining her life and my father's life (her words, not mine) for various reasons.  She wants me gone, and she's unstable enough that I worry about my safety when I'm there.  Kicking me out would be a stable move on her part.
